vendor_and_service: Billing and revenue cycle platform with clearinghouse (SYS-03)

assurance_required: Annual SOC 2 Type 2 (Security, Availability, Processing Integrity, Confidentiality) plus bridge letter
subservice_organizations: Hosting provider carved out; the vendor's clearinghouse affiliate included (inclusive method)
exceptions_noted: 2 exceptions: 1 of 25 terminated vendor engineers removed late; 2 of 40 coding rule changes lacked documented approval. Remediated per management response
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Customer user administration and role assignment; review of import exception reports; customer-configured AI coding review thresholds; review of workspace access. Mapped to AC-2, AC-6, SI-10, SI-7. Company gaps: quarterly reviews (POAM-001), workspace review (POAM-020), straight-through AI coding (POAM-022)
availability_vs_bia: Stated RTO 24 hours and RPO 4 hours; BIA needs RTO 48 hours and RPO 24 hours for BP-08 and BP-09: meets BIA
incident_notification_terms: BAA: breach notice within 30 days; security incidents "promptly". Client BAAs require the company to notify clients within 10 business days, so the vendor term is too long
follow_up: Negotiate 5-business-day breach and security incident notice; request a workspace permission report each quarter; ask that AI coding accuracy be tested under Processing Integrity in the next report (the model was excluded from testing)
reviewer_and_date: Compliance and Privacy Officer and Director of Revenue Cycle, 2026-09-03
